findings.highlight: I have to do everything I can.
findings.governingReading: きっぱりと言う describes the delivery of his immediately preceding recipe correction.
findings.explanation: A firm utterance becomes an obligation to do everything possible.

findings.evidenceJa: 煙が出るまで鍋を空焼きしとけば
findings.governingReading: Shirou specifies heating the empty pan until it smokes before reassuring Taiga that even she can manage the cooking.
findings.explanation: A precise instruction to heat the empty pan until it smokes becomes generic preheating. Shirou's practical reassurance to Taiga remains.
